description.id: Metadata ringkas 25 nabi dan rasul yang dikenal luas dalam tradisi Islam. Uraian dibatasi pada informasi yang dinyatakan Al-Quran.
description.en: Concise metadata for the 25 prophets and messengers widely recognized in Islamic tradition. Descriptions are limited to information stated in the Quran.

description.id: Allah menciptakannya dan mengajarkan kepadanya nama-nama; kisahnya mencakup perintah agar para malaikat bersujud.
description.en: Allah created him and taught him the names; his account includes the command for the angels to prostrate.

description.id: Al-Quran menyebutnya sebagai seorang yang sangat benar dan seorang nabi, serta diangkat ke martabat yang tinggi.
description.en: The Quran identifies him as a man of truth and a prophet, raised to a high station.

description.id: Ia menyeru kaumnya menyembah Allah dan, atas wahyu Allah, membuat bahtera ketika kaumnya menolak seruannya.
description.en: He called his people to worship Allah and, by revelation, built the Ark when they rejected his call.

description.id: Ia diutus kepada kaum 'Ad dan menyeru mereka menyembah Allah tanpa mempersekutukan-Nya.
description.en: He was sent to the people of Ad and called them to worship Allah without partners.

description.id: Ia diutus kepada kaum Tsamud; unta betina Allah diberikan sebagai tanda bagi mereka.
description.en: He was sent to Thamud; the she-camel of Allah was given to them as a sign.

description.id: Ia menolak penyembahan berhala, diuji oleh Allah, dan bersama Ismail meninggikan fondasi Ka'bah.
description.en: He rejected idol worship, was tested by Allah, and with Ishmael raised the foundations of the Kaaba.

description.id: Ia memperingatkan kaumnya terhadap perbuatan keji; ia dan keluarganya diselamatkan kecuali istrinya.
description.en: He warned his people against grave immorality; he and his family were saved except for his wife.

description.id: Ia disebut benar janjinya, seorang rasul dan nabi; bersama Ibrahim ia meninggikan fondasi Ka'bah.
description.en: He is described as true to his promise, a messenger and prophet; with Abraham he raised the foundations of the Kaaba.

description.id: Kelahirannya dikabarkan kepada Ibrahim dan istrinya, dan ia disebut sebagai nabi yang saleh.
description.en: His birth was announced to Abraham and his wife, and he is named as a righteous prophet.

description.id: Ia juga disebut Israel dan menasihati anak-anaknya agar tetap berserah diri kepada Allah.
description.en: He is also called Israel and instructed his children to remain in submission to Allah.

description.id: Al-Quran mengisahkan ujian yang dialaminya, pemenjaraannya, kemampuannya menafsirkan mimpi, dan pertemuannya kembali dengan keluarga.
description.en: The Quran recounts his trials, imprisonment, interpretation of dreams, and reunion with his family.

description.id: Ia memohon kepada Allah ketika ditimpa kesusahan; Allah menghilangkan kesusahannya dan memulihkan keluarganya.
description.en: He called upon Allah when afflicted by hardship; Allah removed his distress and restored his family.

description.id: Ia diutus kepada penduduk Madyan dan menyeru mereka menyembah Allah serta menyempurnakan takaran dan timbangan.
description.en: He was sent to the people of Midian and called them to worship Allah and give full measure and weight.

description.id: Allah mengutusnya kepada Firaun, memberinya tanda-tanda, dan menurunkan Taurat sebagai petunjuk.
description.en: Allah sent him to Pharaoh, gave him signs, and revealed the Torah as guidance.

description.id: Ia adalah saudara Musa, seorang nabi, dan pendamping dalam menyampaikan risalah kepada Firaun.
description.en: He was Moses' brother, a prophet, and his companion in delivering the message to Pharaoh.

description.id: Al-Quran menyebutnya bersama orang-orang yang sabar dan saleh, tanpa memberikan rincian riwayat hidup.
description.en: The Quran names him among the patient and righteous without giving biographical details.

description.id: Allah memberinya kerajaan, hikmah, dan Zabur; gunung-gunung dan burung-burung bertasbih bersamanya.
description.en: Allah gave him kingship, wisdom, and the Psalms; the mountains and birds glorified Allah with him.

description.id: Ia mewarisi Daud dan dianugerahi kerajaan serta pemahaman; Al-Quran menegaskan bahwa ia tidak kafir.
description.en: He succeeded David and was granted kingship and understanding; the Quran explicitly states that he did not disbelieve.

description.id: Ia termasuk para rasul dan menyeru kaumnya agar bertakwa serta meninggalkan penyembahan Baal.
description.en: He was among the messengers and called his people to be mindful of Allah and abandon the worship of Baal.

description.id: Al-Quran menyebutnya di antara orang-orang yang diberi keutamaan dan orang-orang pilihan, tanpa rincian kisah.
description.en: The Quran names him among those favored and chosen, without detailing his story.

description.id: Ia termasuk para rasul; ketika berada dalam kegelapan ia berdoa kepada Allah dan kemudian diselamatkan.
description.en: He was among the messengers; while in darkness he called upon Allah and was then delivered.

description.id: Ia berdoa memohon keturunan yang baik; Allah mengabulkannya dengan kabar kelahiran Yahya.
description.en: He prayed for righteous offspring; Allah answered him with the announcement of John.

description.id: Allah memberinya hikmah sejak kanak-kanak serta menyebutnya suci, berbakti, dan seorang nabi.
description.en: Allah gave him wisdom as a child and describes him as pure, dutiful, and a prophet.

description.id: Ia adalah Al-Masih, putra Maryam, seorang rasul Allah yang kelahirannya menjadi tanda; Allah memberinya Injil dan mukjizat dengan izin-Nya.
description.en: He is the Messiah, son of Mary, and a messenger of Allah whose birth was a sign; Allah gave him the Gospel and miracles by His permission.

description.id: Ia adalah rasul Allah dan penutup para nabi; Al-Quran diturunkan kepadanya sebagai petunjuk bagi manusia.
description.en: He is the messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets; the Quran was revealed to him as guidance for humanity.
